niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, high-clarity interfaces with strong hierarchy, clear modular grouping, and enough visible content to feel complete and actionable. They consistently like spacious but structured layouts, concise benefit-led copy, restrained headers, and distinctive visual personality through icons, contrast, depth, and contemporary styling. In darker or alert-oriented contexts they often favor cinematic contrast, richer depth, and stronger urgency cues, but they also show some inconsistency on overall brightness and density depending on task context.

criteria.description: Clear top-down hierarchy with a bold headline, obvious focal point, and well-separated sections that guide attention decisively.
Content organized into clearly separated modules or grouped sections, with each concept framed cleanly rather than blended together.
Layouts with breathing room, predictable vertical rhythm, and reduced crowding, while still maintaining structure and flow.
Screens that feel populated, feature-complete, and operational, with visible options, actions, or examples rather than sparse or placeholder-like layouts.
Minimal, compact header treatment with limited decorative noise, avoiding dominant hero imagery, busy branded headers, or competing top-of-screen elements.
A calm but contemporary aesthetic with refined polish, memorable brand character, and a more distinctive, taste-forward look over generic utilitarian UI.
Use of colorful, expressive icons or icon chips that add personality and improve scanability and semantic clarity.
Short, distilled, benefit-focused or conversational explanatory copy rather than wordy, procedural, or setup-heavy text.
Stronger contrast, dimensional layering, and visually assertive emphasis that create focus, depth, and a more premium or cinematic feel.
